ask: How does ZIGoals keep my data?
reply:
ZIGoals keeps your records on this device, in the browser. Nothing is uploaded unless you turn on encrypted sync for an account.

If you do turn on sync, your records are encrypted on the device before they leave it. The server stores only the encrypted data and what it needs to deliver it, so it cannot read your plans, habits or health entries. Signing in with an email code does not recover your data. Only your recovery secret unlocks it.

Health syncs only after a separate opt-in. Backups are optional too: an encrypted backup with its own secret, readable exports for each area, or a full export as a readable ZIP.

I am ZIGi, your own AI assistant, connected with your key, a local model or OpenRouter sign-in. ZIGoals runs no AI service and does not see our conversation.
